name: @omniharness/app-desktop
description: OmniHarness 桌面端（Electron 壳 + 应用自己的 React 工作台；后端由外部宿主提供）
author: mylong227

scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run stage && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.yml && npm run verify:package
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run stage && electron-builder --win --x64 --config electron-builder.yml && npm run verify:package
scripts.dist:ci: npm run build && npm run stage && electron-builder --win --x64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish never && npm run verify:package
